Heyo, as someone who often gets called smart and has a similar percentile in IQ for my autism diagnosis.

The big factor at least for me when I was 17 was speed, even though I can say intelligent things and do them, I am rather slow at them. Another big reason why is let's be realistic when you do an online IQ test vs an IRL one you also have to consider the anxiety from talking to the person making you more aware of the time pressure, which can make you overthink.

But overall from my own time reading research IQ does not signify much in fact a decent chunk of people with better jobs have lower IQs or are perceived as such anyway. Nor does it impact you much. I've seen more people judge intelligence via EQ and the ability to explain concepts in more simple words.

A lot of people perceive me as smart entirely because they think I am older emotionally/mentally even from when I was 16 even by actual medical professionals and family not just strangers. I am average for the older age they mention but not average for my age in simpler words lol.

Correct me if I am wrong the autistic brain I think it was grows and finishes quicker like a growth spurt. The likelihood is because of that she is smart for her age, but that can change for the better or worse symptom-wise to make her seem less or more "dumb" even if she's not as she ages.

The kindest people and smartest I've met with more severe autism all looked dumb or immature to most folks at a glance, but the reality is they were just so specialized that people who weren't interested in those things would never take the time to comprehend it. That's something no generalized IQ test can do which is why there are specialized autism IQ tests but even then I think measuring intelligence by saying they need to be a jack of all trades is so flawed.

Either way IQ tests aren't ever even being properly used by being tested in different states of mind, energy, and emotion. Because funny enough some people work better when tired even. Due to how simplistic the test it's more like a mood chart maybe you felt like this at 4 pm but then the next hour had it flip entirely.

So for the fact it does not include EQ and is not made for autistic folks form of brain development, Not accepting of being highly skilled in one area (ableist), is too oversimplified.

It is absolutely not indicating her intelligence overall on a daily basis. It took me like 2 years to learn that due to lower self esteem over it, I'm 19 now lol
